philippines.title: Misamis Oriental eyes flights from South Korea starting February 2027
philippines.description:
ILIGAN CITY – Misamis Oriental province is seeking to strengthen its international tourism links with South Korea through a proposed chartered flight service expected to begin in February 2027, Gov. Juliette T. Uy said. In a statement, Uy said the initiative aims to attract more South Korean tourists to the province, boost its tourism industry, create business opportunities and stimulate economic activity.
